# ============================================================
# STEP 2 — Merge RPI (Retail Price Index) Data
# ============================================================

def merge_rpi(train_df, test_df):
    """
    Merge Retail Price Index (RPI) data into train and test DataFrames.
    Adds 'rpi' column reflecting market trend for each transaction.
    """
    # RPI periods and values
    rpi_periods = [
        '2025 3Q', '2025 2Q', '2025 1Q', '2024 4Q', '2024 3Q', '2024 2Q', '2024 1Q', '2023 4Q', '2023 3Q', '2023 2Q', '2023 1Q',
        '2022 4Q', '2022 3Q', '2022 2Q', '2022 1Q', '2021 4Q', '2021 3Q', '2021 2Q', '2021 1Q', '2020 4Q', '2020 3Q',
        '2020 2Q', '2020 1Q', '2019 4Q', '2019 3Q', '2019 2Q', '2019 1Q', '2018 4Q', '2018 3Q', '2018 2Q', '2018 1Q',
        '2017 4Q', '2017 3Q', '2017 2Q', '2017 1Q'
    ]
    rpi_values = [
        203.7, 202.9, 201, 197.9, 192.9, 187.9, 183.7, 180.4, 178.5, 176.2, 173.6,
        171.9, 168.1, 163.9, 159.5, 155.7, 150.6, 146.4, 142.2, 138.1, 133.9,
        131.9, 131.5, 131.5, 130.9, 130.8, 131, 131.4, 131.6, 131.7, 131.6,
        132.6, 132.8, 133.7, 133.9
    ]
    rpi_df = pd.DataFrame({'period': rpi_periods, 'rpi': rpi_values})
    rpi_df[['year', 'quarter']] = rpi_df['period'].str.split(' ', expand=True)
    rpi_df['year'] = rpi_df['year'].astype(int)
    rpi_df['quarter'] = rpi_df['quarter'].str.replace('Q', '').astype(int)
    rpi_df = rpi_df[['year', 'quarter', 'rpi']]

    def add_rpi(df):
        df['year'] = df['MONTH'].str[:4].astype(int)
        df['quarter'] = ((df['MONTH'].str[5:7].astype(int) - 1) // 3 + 1)
        df = df.merge(rpi_df, on=['year', 'quarter'], how='left')
        return df.drop(columns=['year', 'quarter'])

    print("Merging RPI data...")
    train_df = add_rpi(train_df)
    test_df = add_rpi(test_df)
    print("Merging RPI data completed.")
    return train_df, test_df

# --- Apply RPI merge early in your pipeline ---
train_df, test_df = merge_rpi(train_df, test_df)

# Define join columns
block_join_cols = ['BLOCK', 'TOWN', 'STREET']
aux_join_cols = ['BLOCK', 'TOWN', 'ADDRESS']

# Standardize join columns (lowercase, strip whitespace)
for col in ['BLOCK', 'TOWN', 'STREET']:
    train_df[col] = train_df[col].str.lower().str.strip()
    test_df[col] = test_df[col].str.lower().str.strip()

hdb_block_details_df['BLOCK'] = hdb_block_details_df['BLOCK'].str.lower().str.strip()
hdb_block_details_df['TOWN'] = hdb_block_details_df['TOWN'].str.lower().str.strip()
hdb_block_details_df['ADDRESS'] = hdb_block_details_df['ADDRESS'].str.lower().str.strip()

# Merge block-level features into train and test sets
train_df = train_df.merge(
    hdb_block_details_df,
    left_on=block_join_cols,
    right_on=aux_join_cols,
    how='left',
    suffixes=('', '_block')
)
test_df = test_df.merge(
    hdb_block_details_df,
    left_on=block_join_cols,
    right_on=aux_join_cols,
    how='left',
    suffixes=('', '_block')
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 4 -  Data Cleaning & Normalization
# ============================================================

def normalize_columns(df):
    """Unify column names for lease commence year."""
    if "LEASE_COMMENCE_DATA" in df.columns and "LEASE_COMMENCE_DATE" not in df.columns:
        df = df.rename(columns={"LEASE_COMMENCE_DATA": "LEASE_COMMENCE_DATE"})
    return df

def to_lower_strip(df, cols):
    """Lowercase and strip whitespace from text columns."""
    for c in cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = df[c].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    return df

def canonicalize_flat_type(df):
    """Standardize FLAT_TYPE spellings."""
    canon_map = {
        "1 room": "1-room", "2 room": "2-room", "3 room": "3-room",
        "4 room": "4-room", "5 room": "5-room",
        "1-room": "1-room", "2-room": "2-room", "3-room": "3-room",
        "4-room": "4-room", "5-room": "5-room",
        "multi generation": "multi generation", "executive": "executive"
    }
    if "FLAT_TYPE" in df.columns:
        df["FLAT_TYPE"] = df["FLAT_TYPE"].map(lambda x: canon_map.get(x, x))
    return df

# Apply cleaning
train_df = normalize_columns(train_df)
train_df = to_lower_strip(train_df, ["TOWN", "FLAT_TYPE", "BLOCK", "STREET", "FLOOR_RANGE", "FLAT_MODEL", "ECO_CATEGORY"])
train_df = canonicalize_flat_type(train_df)

test_df = normalize_columns(test_df)
test_df = to_lower_strip(test_df, ["TOWN", "FLAT_TYPE", "BLOCK", "STREET", "FLOOR_RANGE", "FLAT_MODEL", "ECO_CATEGORY"])
test_df = canonicalize_flat_type(test_df)

# --- Drop ECO_CATEGORY if constant ---
if "ECO_CATEGORY" in train_df.columns and train_df["ECO_CATEGORY"].nunique(dropna=False) <= 1:
    train_df = train_df.drop(columns=["ECO_CATEGORY"])
    test_df  = test_df.drop(columns=["ECO_CATEGORY"])

print("✅ Data cleaning completed!")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Basic information

print(f"  Test data: {test_df.shape[0]:,} rows × {test_df.shape[1]} columns")

# Target variable basic stats
if 'RESALE_PRICE' in train_df.columns:
    prices = train_df['RESALE_PRICE']
    print(f"\n Target Variable (RESALE_PRICE) Overview:")
    print(f"  Range: ${prices.min():,.0f} - ${prices.max():,.0f}")
    print(f"  Mean: ${prices.mean():,.0f}")
    print(f"  Median: ${prices.median():,.0f}")
    print(f"  Std Dev: ${prices.std():,.0f}")
    print(f"  Skewness: {stats.skew(prices):.3f}")
    print(f"  Kurtosis: {stats.kurtosis(prices):.3f}")

# Data types overview
print(f"\n Data Types Summary:")
dtype_counts = train_df.dtypes.value_counts()
for dtype, count in dtype_counts.items():
    print(f"  {dtype}: {count} columns")

# Missing values analysis
print(f"\n Missing Values Analysis:")
missing_train = train_df.isnull().sum()
missing_test = test_df.isnull().sum()

has_missing = False
for col in train_df.columns:
    train_missing = missing_train[col]
    test_missing = missing_test[col] if col in test_df.columns else 0
    
    if train_missing > 0 or test_missing > 0:
        has_missing = True
        train_pct = train_missing / len(train_df) * 100
        test_pct = test_missing / len(test_df) * 100 if col in test_df.columns else 0
        print(f"  {col}: Train {train_missing} ({train_pct:.1f}%), Test {test_missing} ({test_pct:.1f}%)")

if not has_missing:
    print("  ✅ No missing values detected!")

print(" CATBOOST-SPECIFIC CATEGORICAL ANALYSIS")

# Analyze categorical features cardinality (important for CatBoost)
categorical_features = ['TOWN', 'FLAT_TYPE', 'FLAT_MODEL', 'FLOOR_RANGE', 'STREET']

print("\n Categorical Features Cardinality Analysis:")
cardinality_analysis = {}

for col in categorical_features:
    if col in train_df.columns:
        unique_count = train_df[col].nunique()
        cardinality_level = 'High' if unique_count > 50 else 'Medium' if unique_count > 10 else 'Low'
        missing_rate = train_df[col].isnull().mean() * 100
        
        cardinality_analysis[col] = {
            'unique_count': unique_count,
            'cardinality_level': cardinality_level,
            'missing_rate': missing_rate
        }
        
        print(f"\n   {col}:")
        print(f"    - Unique values: {unique_count}")
        print(f"    - Cardinality level: {cardinality_level}")
        print(f"    - Missing rate: {missing_rate:.1f}%")
        
        # Analyze relationship with target variable
        if 'RESALE_PRICE' in train_df.columns and unique_count < 100:
            group_stats = train_df.groupby(col)['RESALE_PRICE'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count'])
            price_variance = group_stats['mean'].var()
            print(f"    - Price variance across categories: ${price_variance:,.0f}")
            
            # Show top and bottom categories by price
            top_categories = group_stats.sort_values('mean', ascending=False).head(3)
            print(f"    - Top 3 highest price categories:")
            for idx, row in top_categories.iterrows():
                print(f"      • {idx}: ${row['mean']:,.0f} (n={row['count']})")

    for idx, row in top_combinations.iterrows():

print(" ADVANCED TARGET VARIABLE ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 60)

if 'RESALE_PRICE' in train_df.columns:
    prices = train_df['RESALE_PRICE']
    
    # Statistical analysis
    print(f"\n Statistical Properties:")
    print(f"  Range: ${prices.min():,.0f} - ${prices.max():,.0f}")
    print(f"  Mean: ${prices.mean():,.0f}")
    print(f"  Median: ${prices.median():,.0f}")
    print(f"  Standard Deviation: ${prices.std():,.0f}")
    print(f"  Coefficient of Variation: {prices.std()/prices.mean():.3f}")
    print(f"  Skewness: {stats.skew(prices):.3f} ({'Right-skewed' if stats.skew(prices) > 0 else 'Left-skewed'})")
    print(f"  Kurtosis: {stats.kurtosis(prices):.3f} ({'Heavy-tailed' if stats.kurtosis(prices) > 0 else 'Light-tailed'})")
    
    # Outlier analysis
    Q1 = prices.quantile(0.25)
    Q3 = prices.quantile(0.75)
    IQR = Q3 - Q1
    outliers = prices[(prices < Q1 - 1.5*IQR) | (prices > Q3 + 1.5*IQR)]
    
    print(f"\n Outlier Analysis:")
    print(f"  IQR: ${IQR:,.0f}")
    print(f"  Lower fence: ${Q1 - 1.5*IQR:,.0f}")
    print(f"  Upper fence: ${Q3 + 1.5*IQR:,.0f}")
    print(f"  Outliers: {len(outliers)} ({len(outliers)/len(prices)*100:.1f}%)")
    
    # Price distribution visualization
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))
    
    # 1. Original distribution
    axes[0,0].hist(prices, bins=50, alpha=0.7, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
    axes[0,0].set_title('Price Distribution', fontweight='bold')
    axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Price (SGD)')
    axes[0,0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
    axes[0,0].axvline(prices.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Mean: ${prices.mean():,.0f}')
    axes[0,0].axvline(prices.median(), color='green', linestyle='--', label=f'Median: ${prices.median():,.0f}')
    axes[0,0].legend()
    
    # 2. Log distribution
    log_prices = np.log(prices)
    axes[0,1].hist(log_prices, bins=50, alpha=0.7, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black')
    axes[0,1].set_title('Log Price Distribution', fontweight='bold')
    axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Log(Price)')
    axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
    
    # 3. Box plot
    box_plot = axes[0,2].boxplot(prices, patch_artist=True)
    box_plot['boxes'][0].set_facecolor('lightcoral')
    axes[0,2].set_title('Price Box Plot', fontweight='bold')
    axes[0,2].set_ylabel('Price (SGD)')
    
    # 4. Q-Q plot
    stats.probplot(log_prices, dist="norm", plot=axes[1,0])
    axes[1,0].set_title('Q-Q Plot (Log Prices)', fontweight='bold')
    
    # 5. Price ranges
    price_ranges = pd.cut(prices, bins=10)
    range_counts = price_ranges.value_counts().sort_index()
    range_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1,1], color='coral', alpha=0.7)
    axes[1,1].set_title('Price Range Distribution', fontweight='bold')
    axes[1,1].set_xlabel('Price Ranges')
    axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Count')
    axes[1,1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    
    # 6. Outliers visualization
    axes[1,2].scatter(range(len(prices)), prices, alpha=0.5, s=1, color='blue')
    axes[1,2].axhline(y=Q1 - 1.5*IQR, color='red', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label='Lower Threshold')
    axes[1,2].axhline(y=Q3 + 1.5*IQR, color='red', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label='Upper Threshold')
    axes[1,2].set_title(f'Outliers Detection\n({len(outliers)} outliers, {len(outliers)/len(prices)*100:.1f}%)', fontweight='bold')
    axes[1,2].set_xlabel('Sample Index')
    axes[1,2].set_ylabel('Price (SGD)')
    axes[1,2].legend()
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('enhanced_target_analysis.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()
    
    # Price percentiles
    print(f"\n Price Percentiles:")
    percentiles = [5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 95, 99]
    for p in percentiles:
        value = prices.quantile(p/100)
        print(f"  {p:2d}th percentile: ${value:,.0f}")

# ============================================================
# EDA STEP 4 — Feature Importance Prediction
# ============================================================

print(" FEATURE IMPORTANCE PREDICTION")
print("=" * 60)

# Based on correlation predict feature importance
if 'RESALE_PRICE' in train_df.columns:
    numeric_cols = train_df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
    numeric_cols = [col for col in numeric_cols if col != 'RESALE_PRICE']
    
    correlations = {}
    for col in numeric_cols:
        if col in train_df.columns:
            corr = abs(train_df[col].corr(train_df['RESALE_PRICE']))
            if not np.isnan(corr):
                correlations[col] = corr
    
    # Sort and visualize
    sorted_corr = sorted(correlations.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    print(" Predicted Feature Importance (Top 15):")
    for i, (feature, corr) in enumerate(sorted_corr[:15]):
        print(f"  {i+1:2d}. {feature:<25}: {corr:.3f}")
    
    # Visualization
    if len(sorted_corr) > 0:
        features, corrs = zip(*sorted_corr[:15])
        
        plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
        bars = plt.barh(features, corrs, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7)
        plt.title('Predicted Feature Importance (Based on Correlation)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
        plt.xlabel('Absolute Correlation with Target', fontsize=12)
        plt.gca().invert_yaxis()
        
        # Add value labels
        for bar, corr in zip(bars, corrs):
            plt.text(bar.get_width() + 0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
                    f'{corr:.3f}', va='center', fontsize=10)
        
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.savefig('predicted_feature_importance.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        plt.show()

print("\n✅ Feature importance prediction completed!")

# ============================================================
# EDA STEP 5 — Enhanced Temporal Analysis
# ============================================================

print(" ENHANCED TEMPORAL ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 60)

if 'MONTH' in train_df.columns:
    # Time feature engineering
    train_df_temp = train_df.copy()
    train_df_temp['date'] = pd.to_datetime(train_df_temp['MONTH'], format="%Y-%m", errors="coerce")
    train_df_temp['year'] = train_df_temp['date'].dt.year
    train_df_temp['month'] = train_df_temp['date'].dt.month
    train_df_temp['quarter'] = train_df_temp['date'].dt.quarter
    train_df_temp['day_of_year'] = train_df_temp['date'].dt.dayofyear
    
    # Analysis
    monthly_stats = train_df_temp.groupby('MONTH')['RESALE_PRICE'].agg(['mean', 'count', 'std'])
    yearly_stats = train_df_temp.groupby('year')['RESALE_PRICE'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
    seasonal_stats = train_df_temp.groupby('month')['RESALE_PRICE'].mean()
    
    print(" Temporal Patterns:")
    print(f"  Data spans: {train_df_temp['date'].min()} to {train_df_temp['date'].max()}")
    print(f"  Total months: {len(monthly_stats)}")
    print(f"  Years covered: {train_df_temp['year'].nunique()}")
    
    # Annual growth rate
    if len(yearly_stats) > 1:
        growth_rates = yearly_stats['mean'].pct_change().dropna()
        print(f"  Average annual growth rate: {growth_rates.mean()*100:.1f}%")
    
    # Seasonal analysis
    print(f"\n Seasonal Analysis:")
    seasons = {1: 'Winter', 2: 'Winter', 3: 'Spring', 4: 'Spring', 5: 'Spring', 6: 'Summer',
              7: 'Summer', 8: 'Summer', 9: 'Fall', 10: 'Fall', 11: 'Fall', 12: 'Winter'}
    
    for month in range(1, 13):
        if month in seasonal_stats.index:
            season = seasons[month]
            price = seasonal_stats[month]
            print(f"  Month {month:2d} ({season:<6}): ${price:,.0f}")
    
    # Visualization
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 10))
    
    # Monthly price trend
    monthly_stats['mean'].plot(ax=axes[0,0], marker='o', linewidth=2)
    axes[0,0].set_title('Monthly Average Price Trend')
    axes[0,0].set_ylabel('Average Price (SGD)')
    axes[0,0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    axes[0,0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    
    # Monthly transaction volume
    monthly_stats['count'].plot(ax=axes[0,1], marker='s', color='orange', linewidth=2)
    axes[0,1].set_title('Monthly Transaction Volume')
    axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
    axes[0,1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    axes[0,1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    
    # Seasonal patterns
    seasonal_stats.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1,0], color='green', alpha=0.7)
    axes[1,0].set_title('Seasonal Price Patterns')
    axes[1,0].set_xlabel('Month')
    axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Average Price (SGD)')
    axes[1,0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
    
    # Price volatility
    monthly_stats['std'].plot(ax=axes[1,1], marker='^', color='red', linewidth=2)
    axes[1,1].set_title('Monthly Price Volatility')
    axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Price Standard Deviation')
    axes[1,1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    axes[1,1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('enhanced_temporal_analysis.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

# ============================================================
# STEP 5 — Feature Engineering
# ============================================================

# --- Lease Features: Calculate flat age and remaining lease ---
def add_lease_features(df):
    yr = df["LEASE_COMMENCE_DATE"].astype("Int64")
    if "SALE_YEAR" not in df.columns:
        # Add time features if not already present
        dt = pd.to_datetime(df["MONTH"], format="%Y-%m", errors="coerce")
        df["SALE_YEAR"]  = dt.dt.year
    df["FLAT_AGE"] = df["SALE_YEAR"] - yr
    df["REMAINING_LEASE"] = 99 - df["FLAT_AGE"]
    return df

train_df = add_lease_features(train_df)
test_df  = add_lease_features(test_df)

# --- Time Features: Extract year, month, and create a month index ---
def add_time_features(df):
    dt = pd.to_datetime(df["MONTH"], format="%Y-%m", errors="coerce")
    df["SALE_YEAR"]  = dt.dt.year
    df["SALE_MONTH"] = dt.dt.month
    base = dt.min()
    df["MONTH_IDX"] = ((dt.dt.year - base.year) * 12 + (dt.dt.month - base.month)).astype("Int64")
    return df

train_df = add_time_features(train_df)
test_df  = add_time_features(test_df)

# --- Floor Features: Parse floor range into min, max, and median ---
def parse_floor_range(s):
    m = re.match(r"^\s*(\d{1,2})\s*to\s*(\d{1,2})\s*$", str(s))
    if not m:
        return np.nan, np.nan, np.nan
    lo = int(m.group(1)); hi = int(m.group(2))
    return lo, hi, (lo + hi) / 2.0

for df_ in (train_df, test_df):
    lo_hi_med = df_["FLOOR_RANGE"].apply(parse_floor_range)
    df_["FLOOR_MIN"]    = lo_hi_med.apply(lambda t: t[0])
    df_["FLOOR_MAX"]    = lo_hi_med.apply(lambda t: t[1])
    df_["FLOOR_MEDIAN"] = lo_hi_med.apply(lambda t: t[2])

# --- Room/Area Features: Extract number of rooms, executive flag, and area per room ---
def rooms_from_type(s):
    m = re.match(r"^(\d+)-room$", str(s))
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else np.nan

for df_ in (train_df, test_df):
    df_["ROOMS"] = df_["FLAT_TYPE"].apply(rooms_from_type)
    df_["IS_EXECUTIVE"] = (df_["FLAT_TYPE"] == "executive").astype(int)
    df_["AREA_PER_ROOM"] = df_["FLOOR_AREA_SQM"] / np.where(pd.notna(df_["ROOMS"]) & (df_["ROOMS"] > 0), df_["ROOMS"], np.nan)

# --- Block Features: Parse block number and suffix ---
def split_block(b):
    b = str(b)
    m = re.match(r"^(\d+)([a-z])?$", b)
    if not m: 
        return np.nan, 0
    num = int(m.group(1))
    has_suffix = 1 if m.group(2) else 0
    return num, has_suffix

for df_ in (train_df, test_df):
    vals = df_["BLOCK"].apply(split_block)
    df_["BLOCK_NUM"] = vals.apply(lambda t: t[0])
    df_["BLOCK_HAS_SUFFIX"] = vals.apply(lambda t: t[1])

# --- Frequency Encodings: Count frequency of STREET and BLOCK values ---
for col in ["STREET", "BLOCK"]:
    full = pd.concat([train_df[col], test_df[col]])
    counts = full.value_counts().astype(int)
    train_df[f"{col}_COUNT"] = train_df[col].map(counts)
    test_df[f"{col}_COUNT"]  = test_df[col].map(counts)

# --- Proximity Features: Compute distances to amenities using BallTree ---
def add_essential_features(df, hawkers_df, mrt_stations_df, primary_schools_df, shopping_malls_df):
    """
    Add essential proximity features for HDB resale price prediction using tree-based models.
    """
    # Distance to nearest hawker centre
    hawker_coords = np.radians(hawkers_df[['LATITUDE', 'LONGITUDE']].values)
    tree = BallTree(hawker_coords, metric='haversine')
    hdb_coords = np.radians(df[['LATITUDE', 'LONGITUDE']].values)
    distances, _ = tree.query(hdb_coords, k=1)
    df['distance_to_nearest_hawker'] = distances[:, 0] * 6371  # Convert to km

    # Distance to nearest MRT (open stations only)
    open_mrt = mrt_stations_df[mrt_stations_df['STATUS'].str.lower() == 'open'].copy()
    mrt_coords = np.radians(open_mrt[['LATITUDE', 'LONGITUDE']].values)
    tree = BallTree(mrt_coords, metric='haversine')
    distances, _ = tree.query(hdb_coords, k=1)
    df['distance_to_nearest_mrt'] = distances[:, 0] * 6371

    # Distance to nearest primary school
    school_coords = np.radians(primary_schools_df[['LATITUDE', 'LONGITUDE']].values)
    tree = BallTree(school_coords, metric='haversine')
    distances, _ = tree.query(hdb_coords, k=1)
    df['distance_to_nearest_primary_school'] = distances[:, 0] * 6371

    # Distance to nearest shopping mall
    mall_coords = np.radians(shopping_malls_df[['LATITUDE', 'LONGITUDE']].values)
    tree = BallTree(mall_coords, metric='haversine')
    distances, _ = tree.query(hdb_coords, k=1)
    df['distance_to_nearest_mall'] = distances[:, 0] * 6371

    return df

train_df = add_essential_features(train_df, hawkers_df, mrt_stations_df, primary_schools_df, shopping_malls_df)
test_df = add_essential_features(test_df, hawkers_df, mrt_stations_df, primary_schools_df, shopping_malls_df)


# --- Categorical Codes: Encode FLAT_TYPE, TOWN, FLAT_MODEL as integer codes for interactions ---
train_df["FLAT_TYPE_CODE"] = train_df["FLAT_TYPE"].astype("category").cat.codes
test_df["FLAT_TYPE_CODE"] = test_df["FLAT_TYPE"].astype("category").cat.codes

train_df["TOWN_CODE"] = train_df["TOWN"].astype("category").cat.codes
test_df["TOWN_CODE"] = test_df["TOWN"].astype("category").cat.codes

train_df["FLAT_MODEL_CODE"] = train_df["FLAT_MODEL"].astype("category").cat.codes
test_df["FLAT_MODEL_CODE"] = test_df["FLAT_MODEL"].astype("category").cat.codes



# --- Create _cat columns for all base categoricals (for CatBoost) ---
cat_features_to_create = [
    "MONTH", "TOWN", "FLAT_TYPE", "BLOCK", "STREET", "FLOOR_RANGE", "FLAT_MODEL"
]
for col in cat_features_to_create:
    if col in train_df.columns:
        train_df[col + "_cat"] = train_df[col]
    if col in test_df.columns:
        test_df[col + "_cat"] = test_df[col]




# --- Numeric Interaction Features: Example - area × RPI ---
train_df["FLOOR_AREA_X_RPI"] = train_df["FLOOR_AREA_SQM"] * train_df["rpi"]
test_df["FLOOR_AREA_X_RPI"] = test_df["FLOOR_AREA_SQM"] * test_df["rpi"]

# --- Categorical Interaction Features: Combine categoricals as strings ---
# Double interaction: TOWN × FLAT_TYPE
train_df["TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE"] = train_df["TOWN_cat"].astype(str) + "_" + train_df["FLAT_TYPE_cat"].astype(str)
test_df["TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE"] = test_df["TOWN_cat"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["FLAT_TYPE_cat"].astype(str)

# Triple interaction: TOWN × FLAT_TYPE × FLAT_MODEL
train_df["TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE_X_MODEL"] = (
    train_df["TOWN_cat"].astype(str) + "_" +
    train_df["FLAT_TYPE_cat"].astype(str) + "_" +
    train_df["FLAT_MODEL_cat"].astype(str)
)
test_df["TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE_X_MODEL"] = (
    test_df["TOWN_cat"].astype(str) + "_" +
    test_df["FLAT_TYPE_cat"].astype(str) + "_" +
    test_df["FLAT_MODEL_cat"].astype(str)
)

# Additional interactions: FLAT_TYPE × LEASE_COMMENCE_DATE
for df_ in (train_df, test_df):
    df_["FLAT_TYPE_X_LEASE"] = df_["FLAT_TYPE_cat"].astype(str) + "_" + df_["LEASE_COMMENCE_DATE"].astype(str)




# --- Create _cat columns for all interaction features (for CatBoost) ---
for col in ["TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE", "TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE_X_MODEL", "FLAT_TYPE_X_LEASE"]:
    train_df[col + "_cat"] = train_df[col]
    test_df[col + "_cat"] = test_df[col]

# STEP 6 — CatBoost Feature List, Data Prep & Optuna Tuning
# ============================================================

# --- Full feature list: all original + engineered features ---
base_features = [
    # Original transaction columns
    "MONTH", "TOWN", "FLAT_TYPE", "STREET", "FLOOR_RANGE", "FLOOR_AREA_SQM", "LEASE_COMMENCE_DATE", "FLAT_MODEL",  # "BLOCK"
    # Time features
    "SALE_YEAR", "MONTH_IDX",  # "SALE_MONTH"
    # Floor features
    # "FLOOR_MEDIAN", "FLOOR_MIN", "FLOOR_MAX"
    # Lease/age features
    "REMAINING_LEASE",  # "FLAT_AGE"
    # Room/area features
    # "AREA_PER_ROOM", "ROOMS", "IS_EXECUTIVE"
    # Block features
    "BLOCK_NUM",  # "BLOCK_HAS_SUFFIX"
    # Frequency encodings
    # "STREET_COUNT", # "BLOCK_COUNT"
    # RPI and interactions
    "rpi", "FLOOR_AREA_X_RPI",
    # Categorical interactions (string)
    "TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE", "TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE_X_MODEL", "FLAT_TYPE_X_LEASE",
    # Proximity features
    "distance_to_nearest_mrt",
    # "distance_to_nearest_primary_school",
    "distance_to_nearest_hawker",
    "distance_to_nearest_mall"
]

# Select columns for CatBoost (categoricals as _cat)
catboost_features = [
    c if c not in [
        "MONTH", "TOWN", "FLAT_TYPE", "BLOCK", "STREET", "FLOOR_RANGE", "FLAT_MODEL",
        "TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE", "TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE_X_MODEL", "FLAT_TYPE_X_LEASE"
    ] else c + "_cat"
    for c in base_features if c in train_df.columns
]

# Specify which columns are categorical for CatBoost
cat_cols = [
    "MONTH_cat", "TOWN_cat", "FLAT_TYPE_cat", "STREET_cat", "FLOOR_RANGE_cat", "FLAT_MODEL_cat",
    "TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE_cat", "TOWN_X_FLAT_TYPE_X_MODEL_cat", "FLAT_TYPE_X_LEASE_cat"
]  # "BLOCK_cat" can be added if needed




# --- Data Preparation ---
# Drop duplicate rows in train_df only (DATA LEAKAGE PREVENTION)
train_df = train_df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Prepare X/y and test set for CatBoost
X_cat = train_df[catboost_features].copy()
y_cat = train_df["RESALE_PRICE"].copy()
X_test_cat = test_df[catboost_features].copy()

print("Train shape:", X_cat.shape, " Test shape:", X_test_cat.shape)
print("Features:", base_features, "...", len(base_features), "total")

# --- Bayesian Optimization for CatBoost with Optuna ---
import optuna
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor, Pool
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

def objective(trial):
    params = {
        'loss_function': 'RMSE',
        'learning_rate': trial.suggest_float('learning_rate', 0.03, 0.07),  # Narrowed around 0.05
        'depth': trial.suggest_int('depth', 9, 13),  # Narrowed around 11
        'iterations': trial.suggest_int('iterations', 1700, 2100),  # Narrowed around 1940
        'l2_leaf_reg': trial.suggest_float('l2_leaf_reg', 3.5, 5.5),  # Narrowed around 4.1
        'min_data_in_leaf': trial.suggest_int('min_data_in_leaf', 12, 20),  # Narrowed around 16
        'bagging_temperature': trial.suggest_float('bagging_temperature', 0.7, 1.1),  # Narrowed around 0.88
        'random_strength': trial.suggest_float('random_strength', 0.8, 1.5),  # Narrowed around 1.1
        'subsample': trial.suggest_float('subsample', 0.60, 0.65),  # Narrowed around 0.62
        'colsample_bylevel': trial.suggest_float('colsample_bylevel', 0.85, 0.92),  # Narrowed around 0.88
        'early_stopping_rounds': 100,
        'random_seed': 42,
        'verbose': 0,
        'cat_features': cat_cols
    }
    kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) # Reduced to 5 folds for quicker tuning, default was 10
    oof = np.zeros(len(X_cat))
    for tr_idx, val_idx in kf.split(X_cat):
        train_pool = Pool(X_cat.iloc[tr_idx], y_cat.iloc[tr_idx], cat_features=cat_cols)
        valid_pool = Pool(X_cat.iloc[val_idx], y_cat.iloc[val_idx], cat_features=cat_cols)
        model = CatBoostRegressor(**params)
        model.fit(train_pool, eval_set=valid_pool, use_best_model=True)
        oof[val_idx] = model.predict(X_cat.iloc[val_idx])
    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_cat, oof))
    print(f"Trial {trial.number}: RMSE={rmse:.4f}")
    return rmse

study = optuna.create_study(direction="minimize")
study.optimize(objective, n_trials=25, show_progress_bar=True) # Reduced to 25 trials for quicker tuning, default was 100

print('Best trial:')
print(study.best_trial)
print('Best params:')
print(study.best_trial.params)

# Check for missing values in train_df and test_df (precaution)

def check_missing(df, name="DataFrame"):
    missing = df.isnull().sum()
    missing = missing[missing > 0]
    if missing.empty:
        print(f"No missing values in {name}.")
    else:
        print(f"Missing values in {name}:")
        print(missing.sort_values(ascending=False))

check_missing(train_df, "train_df")
check_missing(test_df, "test_df")

# Check for missing LATITUDE and LONGITUDE in train_df and test_df

def check_missing_coords(df, name="DataFrame"):
    missing_lat = df['LATITUDE'].isnull().sum()
    missing_lon = df['LONGITUDE'].isnull().sum()
    print(f"Missing LATITUDE in {name}: {missing_lat}")
    print(f"Missing LONGITUDE in {name}: {missing_lon}")
    if missing_lat > 0 or missing_lon > 0:
        print(df[df['LATITUDE'].isnull() | df['LONGITUDE'].isnull()][['BLOCK', 'STREET', 'LATITUDE', 'LONGITUDE']].head())

check_missing_coords(train_df, "train_df")
check_missing_coords(test_df, "test_df")

    'iterations': best_params['iterations'],
    'l2_leaf_reg': best_params['l2_leaf_reg'],
    'min_data_in_leaf': best_params['min_data_in_leaf'],
    'bagging_temperature': best_params['bagging_temperature'],
    'random_strength': best_params['random_strength'],
    'early_stopping_rounds': 100,
    'random_seed': 42,
    'verbose': 100,
    'cat_features': cat_cols
}

# 2. Train final CatBoost model on full training data
final_model = CatBoostRegressor(**final_params)
final_model.fit(X_cat, y_cat, cat_features=cat_cols)

# 3. Predict on test set
test_preds_cat = final_model.predict(X_test_cat)

# 4. Prepare Kaggle submission file
def create_submission(preds, submission_path, output_path):
    """
    Create a Kaggle submission file given predictions and template.
    """
    sub = pd.read_csv(submission_path)
    target_col = sub.columns[1]
    sub[target_col] = preds
    sub.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    print(f"{output_path} created, shape: {sub.shape}")
    print(sub.head())

# 5. Generate submission

output_submission = "submission_gm.csv"
create_submission(test_preds_cat, submission_template, output_submission)

# ============================================================
# STEP 8 — CatBoost Feature Importance Visualization
# ============================================================

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def plot_catboost_feature_importance(model, max_features=30):
    """
    Plot and print CatBoost feature importances.
    Args:
        model: Trained CatBoostRegressor model.
        max_features: Number of top features to display in the plot.
    """
    importances = model.get_feature_importance()
    feature_names = model.feature_names_
    sorted_importance = sorted(zip(feature_names, importances), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

    print("CatBoost Feature importances:")
    for feat, score in sorted_importance:
        print(f"{feat}: {score:.4f}")

    # Plot top N features for readability
    top_features = sorted_importance[:max_features]
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    plt.bar([k for k, v in top_features], [v for k, v in top_features])
    plt.xticks(rotation=90)
    plt.title(f"CatBoost Feature Importance (Top {max_features})")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

# Call the function to display feature importances
plot_catboost_feature_importance(final_model, max_features=30)
